snippet.title: Go North - Official Gameplay Trailer | Black Voices in Gaming
snippet.description:
Go North is definitely a cooler take on hedge mazes! In this magical adventure, you'll use all sorts of tools – from hoverboards to robot mice – to navigate the most gorgeous, sprawling mazes you'll have ever seen. But something sinister is corrupting the mazes. Something… or someone.

Wishlist Go North on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041730/Go_North/
